title: verbascum trapifolium
intro: Verbascum trapifolium, commonly known as two-leaved mullein, is a biennial plant species that belongs to the figwort family. The health benefits of Verbascum trapifolium include its ability to soothe respiratory issues and reduce inflammation due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in treating coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum trapifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
